content_html_sanitized:
Posted April 18, 2002

American medical cannabis refuges, Steve Kubby and Steve Tuck were released from custody today in Vancouver on C$5,000 bail each, posted by Marc Emery, who had also paid their attorney fees.

Their arrest earlier this week supposedly on immigration charges -- followed publicity in both DEAland and Canada about American medical cannabis refugees in BC.

On a recent Fox TV news report a thuggish DEA agent said that they would not be safe in Canada. Although the Canadian people overwhelmingly support medical access to cannabis, there are elements in the RCMP who are DEA collaborators. It is likely that a DEA agent accompanied the Canadian police when they arrested the patients.

To make matters worse, Kubby and Tuck were held in a cold cell without proper bedding, or medical attention. Both men were denied any access to medical cannabis, which endangered their lives.

Kubby has a very rare form of adrenal cancer and only cannabis controls his adrenal production and blood pressure.

Tuck is a severely disabled veteran who suffers from severe pain caused by a broken back. Only cannabis makes it possible for him to function. He is wanted in California for running a large medical cannabis club in Humboldt County. The DA that indicted him was recently defeated in his bid for relection, but he will be in office until the end of the year. This was his last chance to kill Tuck.

Although Tuck is also prescribed large amounts of morphine, it was not provided adequately despite the jailers having his Canadian prescription. This is a violation of Canadian law, but the jailers mocked the men as they suffered, just as the Roman soldiers mocked Jesus as they crucified Him.

Both suffered terribly during the last two days.

And all for nothing.

Ironically, the court even dropped the original immigration charges against Kubby, and then the Royal Canadian Marijuana Police, DEA- wannabees, went back to his home and seized his small indoor medical garden. This is particularly pointless, inasmuch as BC courts almost always dismiss cultivation charges against patients.

Ironically, it is likely that the Tucks and Kubbys will now claim refugee status, and will be safe in Canada for at least a year and probably much longer.

This has been a public relations disaster for the narks and the fallout from this exercise in barbarism has just begun.

This has been a very stressful time for their friends. Many, many thanks to Marc Emery, whose generosity literally saved the lives of two innocent men.
